verdict.rationale: Ardent documents a REST API with endpoint reference tables (e.g., connector deletion-lock and quarantine-release endpoints) and role-based auth, so an API reference exists. However, nothing shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, which argues against a generated try-it console. missing for 10: interactive try-it/playground console, runnable request examples, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
